notes: TESTER BUILD: this release has not had a clean fleet pass yet; it is published so testers can run the newest build.

A monitoring tool (AIDA64, HWiNFO, HWMonitor, CPU-Z, GPU-Z, RTSS, Afterburner) keeping your graphics card busy is no longer taken for a game: Game mode, the mouse lock and the game pop-ups start only once a game is really drawing frames.
A screensaver or live wallpaper running on your desktop is no longer taken for a game.

USB screens (an AIO pump screen, fan screens): one that another program holds is tried once and left alone; one that stops answering is closed and tried again after growing gaps, then left alone, instead of being tried every few seconds…
